name: Rudrabhishek at Kashi
description: Ancient Rudra Abhishek performed at the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga with Ganges water, bilva leaves, and Vedic chanting.

name: Somnath Jyotirlinga Abhishek
description: Perform the sacred Abhishekam at the first Jyotirlinga — Somnath. Milk, curd, honey, and Ganga jal poured on the Shivling with Vedic mantras.

name: Maha Mrityunjaya Homa at Srisailam
description: Powerful fire ritual (Homa) invoking Lord Shiva's healing energy. Performed by temple pandits with 108 ahutis at the ancient Srisailam hilltop temple.

name: Navagraha Shanti at Omkareshwar
description: Nine-planet pacification pooja at the sacred island of Omkareshwar on the river Narmada. Ideal for those with graha doshas in their birth chart.

name: Kedarnath Rudrabhishek
description: Sacred Rudrabhishek at 3,583m altitude on the original Kedarnath Jyotirlinga. Snow-capped Himalayan backdrop with ancient Vedic rituals.

name: Badrinath Satyanarayan Katha
description: Remote Satyanarayan Pooja at the sacred Badrinath Dham. Performed by temple pandits on the banks of the Alaknanda river.

name: Nageshwar Sarpa Dosha Nivaran
description: Nag Dosha removal ritual at the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga. Includes Nag Pooja, milk Abhishek, and special mantras for Kaal Sarp Dosh.

name: Trimbakeshwar Kaal Sarp Dosh Pooja
description: The most authentic Kaal Sarp Dosh Nivaran Pooja, performed only at Trimbakeshwar. Includes all 12 rounds of the sacred ritual.

name: Kamakhya Devi Shakti Pooja
description: Powerful Shakti ritual at the most sacred Shakta Pitha — Kamakhya. Includes Tantrik Pooja, Kumkum Archana, and Devi Mahatmya Path.

name: Jagannath Mahaprasad Seva
description: Ancient Mahaprasad offering at Lord Jagannath's kitchen — the largest kitchen in the world. Your name & gotra recited during the offering.

name: 22-Well Abhishekam at Rameshwaram
description: Sacred Abhishekam using water from all 22 holy wells (theerthams) of Rameshwaram. Extremely rare and auspicious ritual.

name: Bhasma Aarti Remote Darshan
description: Witness the legendary 4 AM Bhasma Aarti of Mahakaleshwar via live geotagged video. Includes Rudrabhishek performed with your Sankalpa.
